central_url.description: URL of the Pursers Central MCP endpoint.

board_id.description: Board the MCP server should connect to.

token_file.description: Optional path to an existing worker JWT file. Omit it for the local ~/.pursers/central/worker.jwt default. The relay automatically uses the credential's single agent name; if it has several, the tool asks you to choose one. The token itself never belongs in Zed settings.

ca_file.description: Optional CA certificate file for a TLS Central endpoint.

uvx_path.description: Optional absolute path to the uvx executable.

package_spec.description: Optional package version or local project path passed to uvx --from.
